attributes.value: Convolutional-neural-network stability predictor trained on Rosetta-computed stability changes, operating directly on the input protein structure.

review.reviewer_note: Extractor: Claude integrator agent for issue #88. Reviewer: a separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed.
review.method_note: Compared the store diff with origin/main, read each new description against its cited source passage and checked the licence of each new source record.
review.note: Approved. Checked the 16 Pancotti-derived descriptions word for word against PMC8921618 section 2.2, ESM therm, RaSP and ELASPIC-2 against Chu 2024, ThermoMPNN against Dieckhaus 2024, and ABYSSAL and phyloP against their abstracts; all match. Licences on the new sources are supported by Europe PMC, the PMC XML and Crossref.
